newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks advance cautiously on rate concerns.
newsitem.headline: French stocks advance cautiously on rate concerns.

text.p: French shares rose on Tuesday, the first day of the monthly account, but the market's advance was cautious ahead of an anticipated increase in U.S. interest rates and a string of upcoming corporate results.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 14.41 points, or 0.7 percent, at 2,081.50, while the CAC-40 September futures contract rose 14.50 points to 2,086.

The U.S. Federal Reserve's Federal Open Market Committee met on Tuesday and brokers said a quarter-point rise in U.S. interest rates was probably priced into financial markets, but a bigger increase might trigger a reaction.
Food group Danone rose 2.09 percent to 732 francs after announcing a chilled juice venture with Coca-Cola Foods.

Steelmaker Usinor Sacilor finished 4.46 percent higher at 78.45 francs despite reporting a sharp drop in profit for the first half of the year. Brokers said the market liked the company's bullish medium-term outlook.
Other companies due to report results this week include Alcatel Alsthom and luxury goods group LVMH.
